stateDiagram

TrafficLightRed

TrafficLightRed : TrafficLightRed

TrafficLightRed : enter / #123; turnOnLight(pinRed)#59; time = 0#59; #125;

TrafficLightRed : exit / #123; turnOffLight(pinRed)#59; #125;

TrafficLightRed : tick / #123; time++#59; #125;

TrafficLightRedYellow

TrafficLightRedYellow : TrafficLightRedYellow

TrafficLightRedYellow : enter / #123; turnOnLight(pinRed)#59; turnOnLight(pinYellow)#59; time = 0#59; #125;

TrafficLightRedYellow : exit / #123; turnOffLight(pinRed)#59; turnOffLight(pinYellow)#59; #125;

TrafficLightRedYellow : tick / #123; time++#59; #125;

TrafficLightGreen

TrafficLightGreen : TrafficLightGreen

TrafficLightGreen : enter / #123; turnOnLight(pinGreen)#59; time = 0#59; #125;

TrafficLightGreen : exit / #123; turnOffLight(pinGreen)#59; #125;

TrafficLightGreen : tick / #123; time++#59; #125;

TrafficLightYellow

TrafficLightYellow : TrafficLightYellow

TrafficLightYellow : enter / #123; turnOnLight(pinYellow)#59; time = 0#59; #125;

TrafficLightYellow : exit / #123; turnOffLight(pinYellow)#59; #125;

TrafficLightYellow : tick / #123; time++#59; #125;

state NightMode {

        BlinkOn

        BlinkOn : BlinkOn

        BlinkOn : enter / #123; turnOnLight(pinYellow)#59; time = 0#59; #125;

        BlinkOn : exit / #123; turnOffLight(pinYellow)#59; #125;

        BlinkOn : tick / #123; time++#59; #125;

        BlinkOff

        BlinkOff : BlinkOff

        BlinkOff : enter / #123; time = 0#59; #125;

        BlinkOff : tick / #123; time++#59; #125;

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as NightMode.(InitialState)

}

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

TrafficLightRed --> TrafficLightRedYellow : requestGreen [barrierActive]

TrafficLightRed --> NightMode : tick [brightness < threshold - 100]

TrafficLightRedYellow --> TrafficLightGreen : tick [time > 2000]

TrafficLightGreen --> TrafficLightYellow : tick [time > greenTime]

TrafficLightYellow --> TrafficLightRed : tick [time > 3000]

BlinkOn --> BlinkOff : tick [time > 1000]

BlinkOn --> TrafficLightRed : tick [brightness > threshold + 100]

BlinkOff --> BlinkOn : tick [time > 1000]

BlinkOff --> TrafficLightRed : tick [brightness > threshold + 100]

NightMode.(InitialState) --> BlinkOff

ROOT.(InitialState) --> TrafficLightRed : / #123; initLight(pinRed)#59; initLight(pinYellow)#59; initLight(pinGreen)#59; #125;
